tasks.label: Claude: Validate Framework
args: Write-Host '=== Framework Validation ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $hooks = @('.claude/hooks/agent-router.ps1', '.claude/hooks/skill-router.ps1', '.claude/hooks/conformance-gate.ps1', '.claude/hooks/token-tracker.ps1'); $allGood = $true; foreach ($h in $hooks) { if (Test-Path $h) { Write-Host "✓ $h" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "✗ $h MISSING" -ForegroundColor Red; $allGood = $false } }; if (Test-Path '.claude/settings.json') { Write-Host '✓ settings.json' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✗ settings.json MISSING' -ForegroundColor Red; $allGood = $false }; if (Test-Path 'CLAUDE.md') { Write-Host '✓ CLAUDE.md' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✗ CLAUDE.md MISSING' -ForegroundColor Red; $allGood = $false }; if ($allGood) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== Framework Ready ===' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== Framework Incomplete ===' -ForegroundColor Red }

tasks.label: Claude: Test Agent Router
args: $prompts = @('build a React component', 'write tests for the API', 'debug this error', 'create user authentication', 'design system architecture'); Write-Host '=== Agent Router Test ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; foreach ($p in $prompts) { Write-Host "`nPrompt: $p" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $p | & '.claude/hooks/agent-router.ps1' }

tasks.label: Claude: Test Skill Router
args: Write-Host '=== Skill Router Test (based on current files) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; 'analyzing project' | & '.claude/hooks/skill-router.ps1'

tasks.label: Claude: View Session Stats
args: Write-Host '=== Session Statistics ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path '.claude/logs') { $files = Get-ChildItem '.claude/logs' -Filter '*.log'; foreach ($f in $files) { Write-Host "`n$($f.Name):" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Content $f.FullName | Select-Object -Last 20 } } else { Write-Host 'No logs found' -ForegroundColor Gray }

tasks.label: Claude: Clear Session
args: Write-Host '=== Clearing Session ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Remove-Item '.claude/.session-reminders' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item '.claude/logs/.session-stats' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Session cleared' -ForegroundColor Green
